results.actual_result: Home displayed the starter heading, menu, account/cart and category/policy links.
The dedicated QA category displayed only QA fixture products across its two pages.
Searching QA Run Product 13 displayed exactly one matching product at EUR 13.00.
The run-specific nonexistent token returned 0 products and a usable no-match message.
Inspected category results followed ascending EUR 1–12 and descending EUR 45, 40, 20, 13–5 order on page 1.
Recorded 12 handles on page 1 and 4 on page 2: union 16, intersection 0, matching the 16 prepared category members.
M and White were selected; the page showed EUR 35.00 and the matching fixture variant ID in the URL after hydration.
A nonexistent product displayed Page not found and a frontpage link.
The stock-0 fixture displayed Out of stock and a disabled purchase button.
Store API rejected quantity 2 for stock 1 with HTTP 400 insufficient_inventory; re-read cart contained no items.
The initially empty anonymous cart showed an empty-state message and Explore products, without a checkout action.
Cart contained QA Run Variant Tee, M / White, quantity 1 and EUR 35.00 after one add.
Changing quantity to 2 produced a EUR 70.00 line/subtotal/total, with zero shipping and tax at that state.
Reload retained the M / White line, quantity 2 and EUR 70.00 total.
Removing the QA line returned the cart to Cart (0) and the empty-state message.
Invalid code produced explicit rejection feedback; the single EUR 35.00 item had no discount and total remained EUR 35.00.
QA20261026TEN applied 10% to EUR 35.00: discount EUR 3.50 and pre-shipping total EUR 31.50.
Submitting an empty address stayed at step=address and displayed Please fill out this field at First name.
Fictional DK address advanced to delivery; Standard Shipping was EUR 10.00. Returning to Address preserved entered data; resubmission retained the shipping choice.
Manual Payment created UI order number 2. Persisted M / White quantity 1 matched EUR 35.00 − 3.50 + 10.00 + 0.00 = EUR 41.50.
Repeating completion on an isolated authenticated API cart returned the same order ID twice; order_cart held one distinct order. UI confirmation reload retained order number 2.
Wrong synthetic credentials displayed Invalid email or password and did not show account data.
Valid A credentials showed A account and one address; logout plus reload showed the login form again.

Address read/update as B returned 404 and anonymous returned 401; A address stayed unchanged. A private order history contained its order, B history was empty and anonymous history returned 401. Guest order-by-ID capability was excluded as documented.

Account Customer Service link navigated to /dk/customer-service and rendered Page not found in two UI attempts; independent HTTP request returned 404. Five footer policy/contact targets returned 200; Contact rendered documented starter placeholder text. See BUG-001.

Country selector changed Denmark to France at /fr/contact; the France product page showed EUR 20.00. Returning to the DK product route remained usable; different-region currencies and populated-cart transitions were not evaluated.
